title: Your own cloud, on your own hardware
description: VMs, apps, storage and networking in one Rust platform. Install it on a mini PC, a NAS box or a rack server and run everything from one console, one CLI and one API.

hero.kicker: Open source · AGPLv3 · amd64 and arm64
hero.heading: Your own cloud, on your own hardware.
hero.lead: VMs, apps, storage and networking in one Rust platform. Install it on a mini PC, a NAS box or a rack server and run everything from one console, one CLI and one API.

platform.heading: Stop stitching a hypervisor, a NAS and a container panel together.
platform.lead: Crustates brings compute, storage and networking into one product with one API. Every part is built on proven open source, with Rust in the parts that matter.

tide.body: Full VMs for Windows, Home Assistant OS or OPNsense. Every app in its own microVM by default.
points: QEMU for full VMs, Cloud Hypervisor for microVMs
Compose import and a one-click app catalog
Browser console, USB and GPU passthrough

reef.body: ZFS and Btrfs pools, shares, S3 and backups that run on a schedule and actually restore.

current.body: Bridges, VLANs and firewalling with eBPF, plus HTTPS for every app on its own local name.
points: Per-app firewall rules and flow logs
Remote access with NetBird or Tailscale

secure.heading: Nothing to harden after you install it.

items.title: Read-only OS
items.body: An image-based system with atomic upgrades and one-step rollback.

items.title: A kernel per app
items.body: Apps run in microVMs, so a container escape doesn't reach your host.

items.title: The API is the only way in
items.body: No SSH by default. Passkeys, roles and an audit log of every change.

items.title: Signed from boot
items.body: Secure Boot, a measured boot chain and signed images.

api.heading: Click it, script it or let an agent do it.
api.lead: The console, crust CLI, terminal UI, OpenTofu provider and MCP server all use the same API, documented with an interactive Scalar reference on every node.

assistant.heading: Ask your box. It answers from live state.
assistant.body: "Which VMs use the most RAM?" "Is the photos share backed up?" The assistant reads your setup through the API, runs on a local model by default, and never changes anything without showing you the plan first.
assistant.question: Is the photos share backed up?
assistant.where: local model · stayed on your network
assistant.answer: Yes. tank/photos was backed up at 03:00 to offsite-s3 (412 MiB changed). The last restore test passed 6 days ago.

compare.heading: Coming from Proxmox, TrueNAS or Unraid?
compare.cta: Compare with Proxmox, TrueNAS and Unraid →

molt.body: The whole OS updates as one signed image. If something breaks, roll back with one click.

cast.body: Join a second machine, at home or across town, without port forwarding. Manage them as one.

barnacle.body: Extend it with sandboxed Wasm plugins that only get the permissions you approve.

spawn.body: Keep your setup in a Git repo with a plan on every PR, or push your code and let it build and deploy.

cta.heading: Build your own cloud this weekend.
cta.body: Free and open source. Bring any 64-bit machine with virtualization turned on.
